descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S02 「养老院：同一个住户同一天三次就诊，每条条目来自它自己的记录（真 AI）」 Nursing Home: three same-day visits for one resident, each entry from its own note (live AI)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 3）
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 5）
  • U5 Nursing Home: a same-day revisit appends rather than overwriting the earlier visit's entry (PR #52).（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 5；TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment）
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.3）
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note.（TFA-92589 AC 2；TFA-92589 description 1）
  • U6 Entries never contain signature blocks or placeholders (e.g. '[Physician name]').（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 6；TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician on the local stack; the fixture resident has no course yet

When Three times on the same day: Pre-Round, replace the pre-round field's text with the visit's, Save Note; Encounter, replace the encounter field's text with the visit's, press Generate Note & Finish (it reads "Regenerate Note" once the chart has a note); …

Then Each visit's entry carries a fact said only at that visit's encounter. No entry has a placeholder, a sign-off or 'Encounter done'. Visit 1's text is still there, unchanged, after visits 2 and 3 (not overwritten). Under Quinn's reading of Q1 the timeline shows 'Visit 1 – <today>', 'Visit 2 – <today>' and 'Visit 3 – <today>' once each, in order; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint, scoped to the Visit Timeline. Judged under every reading of Q1 and Q5: each visit's encounter-only facts (mustContainAnyOf), no placeholder, sign-off or 'Encounter done', no 'Visit 4 –', and the post-run storageCheck (snf:get): the Visit 1 entry text seen at s02-after-visit1.md is still in the stored course byte-for-byte, no 'Visit N ·' number is on …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
